lifestyle_adjunct.text:
ORTHOPEDICS — 09/12/2024
40 y/o F, left shoulder pain with overhead reaching x 3 months. Positive impingement signs, cuff strength intact.
Dx: left shoulder impingement. Subacromial injection; home exercise program for rotator cuff 5x/week. Follow-up 6 weeks.

PRIMARY CARE PROGRESS NOTE
Date: 01/02/2026
S: 42 y/o F wants to lose weight in the new year; ankle healed. Evening snacking and takeout. Employer offers a weight management program with coaching.
O: Wt 98.0 kg, Ht 165 cm, BMI 36.0. BP 114/74.
Exam unremarkable.

A/P:
1. Obesity, BMI 36.0 — plan starting today:
 - Calorie tracking, ~1400 kcal/day; cut late-night snacking and takeout.
 - Gym sessions (treadmill + light weights) 3 days a week, ~150 min/week.
 - Enrolling in the employer-sponsored weight management program with monthly coaching.
 Follow-up visits planned.
2. Anxiety — stable on sertraline.
3. GERD — stable.

PATIENT PORTAL MESSAGE — 03/31/2026
Pt: "Just letting you know I stopped going to the weight program and stopped the meal plan this month — my mom had surgery and I'm taking care of her. I'll try to get back to it later."
Reply (RN): Sorry to hear about your mom. Let us know when you're ready to restart; we can reconnect you with the program.

PRIMARY CARE PROGRESS NOTE
Date: 07/01/2026
S: Follow-up. Mother recovering. Ready to get back on track — restarting the diet and walking plan today after a ~3-month break (walking instead of the gym for now, 30 min most days; calorie tracking again). Will rejoin program coaching.
O: Wt 95.8 kg, BMI 35.2. BP 111/73.
A/P:
1. Obesity — restarting lifestyle plan; program re-referral sent.
2. Anxiety — stable, some caregiver stress; counseling resources given.

PRIMARY CARE PROGRESS NOTE
Date: 08/28/2026
S: Follow-up. Back on the diet and walking plan since July; tracking most days and back in program coaching. Weight 95.0 kg today vs 98.0 kg when she first started the lifestyle plan in January (-3.1%). Frustrated with slow progress. Asks about medication. No MTC/MEN2 history, no pancreatitis.
O: Wt 95.0 kg, BMI 34.9. BP 117/80.
